### Professional print layout for PDF and Word export  ·  P1  ·  7 of 8 done  ·  feature 7 / bug 1
The PDF and Word exports have no page numbers, no footer, and no page margins after page 1. Sections start in the middle of a page, and diagrams move away from their headings and tables. This work gives both exports a professional page layout and title-cases a lowercase product name.
